verdict.rationale: Formant documents a dedicated data-export path in which data scientists query telemetry programmatically through the Python Cloud SDK, which calls the query API (formant-docs-3, formant-docs-56). Its Analytics feature also supports custom SQL queries over device and fleet data across a chosen time range (formant-docs-25, formant-docs-36), though that SQL is described for dashboards rather than for export. missing for 10: details on export formats and bulk or offline dataset download, SQL access usable outside dashboards, a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
